details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> ggml : implement the backward pass for TRI (#30712) * ggml: implement the backward pass for TRI GGML_OP_TRI had no case in the backward switch, so a trainable graph containing it aborted with "unsupported ggml op for backward pass: TRI". The op is linear, so its gradient is masked the same way. The incoming gradient is not necessarily contiguous (the backward of a transpose hands over a view) and ggml_tri requires contiguity, so it is made contiguous first. test_tri gains a post_transpose variant (out = transpose(tri(a))) that aborts as above without this change. * ggml : simplify the TRI backward pass Pass the gradient directly to ggml_tri and drop the transpose test. The existing TRI cases cover the backward pass for contiguous F32 gradients. </details> **Website:** - <https://llama.app> **Attestations:** - <https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/attestations/65433828> **macOS/iOS:** - [macOS Apple Silicon (arm64)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download
